tool.name: RFEM Thermal Field Generator
tool.description: Generate a spatially correlated log-normal random diffusivity field

param.name: esd
param.label: Std-dev of D or k
param.help: Log-normal standard deviation — controls spread of material randomness

tool.help:
Generates a spatially correlated log-normal random diffusivity (or conductivity) field and maps it to the model mesh elements by centroid proximity.
Outputs a tar.gz archive containing: - model-{instance_id}.d — mesh with per-element material IDs - model-{instance_id}.dat — updated control file (np_types = nels) - model-{instance_id}.mat — per-element diffusivity values
This archive is passed to the RFEM Thermal Solver together with the shared .fix file.
The random field is generated on a regular rfem grid (nxe × nye × nze) using the sim3de geostatistical routine. Log-normal distribution with spatial correlation controlled by thx/thy/thz (correlation lengths in metres).
To run multiple MC instances, run this tool N times with different instance_id values, then map-over the resulting collection with the solver tool.
